decision: set overlay ENTRYPOINT to vllm serve
why: B12X base uses nvidia_entrypoint with no CMD. Passing the snapshot path as argv0 execs a directory. GLM image already has vllm serve as ENTRYPOINT.
evidence: docker/Dockerfile.b12x-vision ENTRYPOINT; inspect Entrypoint=["vllm","serve"] both nodes; recipe-lint.py

decision: DSpark-5 rejected: num_speculative_tokens must be divisible by n_predict=3
why: Vision-Exp config has num_nextn_predict_layers=3 and dspark_block_size=5. B12X SpeculativeConfig requires tokens % 3 == 0. Next boot uses 6.

decision: skip hash-layer ffn.gate.bias and all bias_vl in plugin load_weights
why: B12X maps gate.bias to e_score_correction_bias. Hash layers 0-2 set that param to None and KeyError. bias_vl has no mapper.

decision: 26.3GiB pin not used on retry. DSpark draft KeyError on bias_vl, not CUDA OOM. Next boot 8GiB KV seqs=2
why: user asked not to OOM. Host still had 115Gi free after the fail. Draft loader looks up bias_vl. Patch skips it and missing gate params.

decision: disable VLLM_USE_B12X_MHC default 0. Keep 8GiB KV and seqs=2
why: Vision-Exp rms_norm_eps is 1e-20. B12X fused Gram MHC requires 1e-6. Not an OOM. 26.3GiB pin stays off.
evidence: config.json rms_norm_eps 1e-20; b12x_mhc_pre ValueError; host available 27Gi at fail

decision: raise KV pin from 8GiB to 12GiB. Keep seqs=2 and MHC off
why: Engine said 1M needs 11.04 GiB. 8GiB estimates max len 289024. After weights CUDA reported 110.59 GiB free so 12GiB is inside the remaining pool.
evidence: kv_cache_utils.py ValueError 11.04 GiB needed vs 8.0 GiB pin

decision: API up max_model_len=1048576. KV pool 1250741 tokens 1.19x at 1M. Text smoke ok
why: 12GiB pin. seqs=2. MHC off. Host available 8.6Gi after smoke. Do not raise pin or seqs.
evidence: kv_cache_utils GPU KV cache size 1250741; curl hello 10 completion tokens
